## Classes

### <a name="domain_join"></a>`domain_join`

This class will domain join a system to Active Directory
The machine's hostname should be set to the FQDN

#### Parameters

The following parameters are available in the `domain_join` class:

* [`username`](#username)
* [`sensitive_password`](#sensitive_password)
* [`global_admins`](#global_admins)
* [`global_ssh`](#global_ssh)
* [`local_admins`](#local_admins)

* [`local_nopasswd`](#local_nopasswd)
* [`sssd_home`](#sssd_home)

* [`domain_short`](#domain_short)
* [`dns_subdomain`](#dns_subdomain)
* [`dnsupdate`](#dnsupdate)

* [`configure_chrony`](#configure_chrony)

* [`update_os_info`](#update_os_info)
* [`enable_smartcard_ssh`](#enable_smartcard_ssh)
* [`oidc`](#oidc)

* [`tenant_id`](#tenant_id)

##### <a name="username"></a>`username`

Data type: `Optional[String]`

The username used to domain join

##### <a name="sensitive_password"></a>`sensitive_password`

Data type: `Optional[Sensitive[String]]`

The password used to domain join

##### <a name="global_admins"></a>`global_admins`

Data type: `String`

An AD group that will have full sudo access on all machines. This will also include ssh access

##### <a name="global_ssh"></a>`global_ssh`

Data type: `String`

Ad AD group that will have ssh access to all machines. Sudo privileges can be specified separately

##### <a name="local_admins"></a>`local_admins`

Data type: `String`

A template for an AD group that will have full sudo access on the specific machine.
`%HOSTNAME%` will be replaced with the machine's shortname

##### <a name="local_ssh"></a>`local_ssh`

Data type: `String`

A template for an AD group that will have ssh access to the specific machine.
`%HOSTNAME%` will be replaced  with the machine's shortname

##### <a name="global_nopasswd"></a>`global_nopasswd`

Data type: `Boolean`

Allow sudo by global_admins without a password

Default value: ``false``

##### <a name="local_nopasswd"></a>`local_nopasswd`

Data type: `Boolean`

Allow sudo by local_admins without a password

Default value: ``false``

##### <a name="sssd_home"></a>`sssd_home`

Data type: `String`

The directory where all home directories should be created. Defaults to /home

Default value: `'/home'`

##### <a name="override_domain"></a>`override_domain`

Data type: `Optional[String]`

Force the name of the domain to join. This can allow the machine's hostname to be set to the short name, but with less sucess

Default value: ``undef``

##### <a name="domain_short"></a>`domain_short`

Data type: `Optional[String]`

The NetBIOS name for the domain

Default value: ``undef``

##### <a name="dns_subdomain"></a>`dns_subdomain`

Data type: `Optional[String]`

The subdomain that the dns records should be registered to. Example: for machine1.sd.example.com, sd would be the subdomain

Default value: ``undef``

##### <a name="dnsupdate"></a>`dnsupdate`

Data type: `Boolean`

If SSSD should create the dns record for the machine. Secure updates are supported

Default value: ``true``

##### <a name="file_header"></a>`file_header`

Data type: `Optional[String]`

A commented header to put on each of the managed files. A global file header can be defined using the top-level variable file_header

Default value: ``undef``

##### <a name="time_servers"></a>`time_servers`

Data type: `Array`

A list of time servers. The domain will automatically be added to the end of the list

Default value: `[]`

##### <a name="configure_chrony"></a>`configure_chrony`

Data type: `Boolean`

Configures Chrony using time servers in time_servers. Time synchronization is required for kerberos to function

Default value: ``true``

##### <a name="smartcard"></a>`smartcard`

Data type: `Enum['disabled', 'enabled', 'required', 'lock-on-removal']`

Enable smartcard authentication (disabled, enabled, required, lock-on-removal)

Default value: `'disabled'`

##### <a name="ad_trust"></a>`ad_trust`

Data type: `Optional[Array[String]]`

Certificate chain for ad certificates (used for smartcard authentication)

Default value: ``undef``

##### <a name="update_os_info"></a>`update_os_info`

Data type: `Boolean`

Configures a service to update the OS information on the AD object on startup

Default value: ``false``

##### <a name="enable_smartcard_ssh"></a>`enable_smartcard_ssh`

Data type: `Boolean`

Enable smartcard authentication for SSH (Only seems to work on RHEL 8+)

Default value: ``false``

##### <a name="oidc"></a>`oidc`

Data type: `Boolean`

Use OIDC for authentication

Default value: ``false``

##### <a name="client_id"></a>`client_id`

Data type: `Optional[String]`

Client ID for OIDC authentication

##### <a name="client_secret"></a>`client_secret`

Data type: `Optional[String]`

Optional secret for client

##### <a name="tenant_id"></a>`tenant_id`

Data type: `Optional[String]`

Tenant ID for Entra ID authentication
